verdict.rationale: Linear documents native iOS and Android apps that support document creation and editing, plus code review, line comments and iterating with Linear Agent on mobile. Nothing shows task or issue management on mobile, or parity with desktop. missing for 10: evidence of issue/task management (create, triage, update) in the mobile app, documented feature parity with desktop, independent or hands-on corroboration of mobile completeness.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can manage my tasks from a full-featured native mobile app without missing desktop functionality

citations.quote: Document creation and editing are now available in Linear's iOS and Android apps.
Use the Linear mobile app to review code changes, comment on specific lines, and iterate with Linear Agent.
